Row.Text: A reign of fire and gold rises, and I its queen.
We advance towards enlightenment. May peace reign.
All roads lead to… well, all roads lead to me.
In our struggles, we have achieved what many thought we could not. And yet still so much more yet to do.
A new realm has formed, and it revolves around me, and my court.
My orb represents divine rule and the scepter my own authority. Together they declare me king of these lands.
Goodness has won out, so goodness may take root in us.
Oh fortune! You are always in motion.
We've crossed the waters of sorrow and entered the land of joy.
I take up the red crown. I raise up the white crown. The gods are appeased. The world is in my grasp.
Look, mother. I have made the earth as glorious as the sun.
Of all the lands I have visited, it is my home that shines above.
The world is set in its apportioned place, and righteousness reigns.
Victory is the child of struggle, joy blossoms from suffering.
Today, liberty has its champion. It is a victory not for me, but for all who strive to be free.
Gold shines from the highest peaks, sun and stone in alignment.
In the wake of struggle, a moment of calm and contemplation of our glory.
